show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/AwQySh
show.description: Madhavan “Maddy,” once a celebrated chef, loses his passion after the sudden death of his wife, Anjali  the soul behind his cooking. His restaurant declines as he drifts through grief, cooking without heart. When Bani, a kind young woman trying to save her failing restaurant, seeks his help, she challenges his emptiness and pushes him back into competitive kitchens. Forced to confront his pain and ruthless rivals, Maddy rediscovers his fire rising again to honor Anjali and reclaim his craft.
